Line 2 (4.6 to 8.9s): replace both static-pad shots (source 1795.0 to 1797.6 and 1800.5 to 1803.2) with motion: the capsule streaking away, the forward heat shield or drogues, or a chute-unfurling shot.
Line 3: replace the two 'fit' tracking-camera shots (source 1837.0 to 1843.0) with full-frame crops of the capsule in flight or the chutes opening.
